scenarios.name: Four bikes, two sites
scenarios.description: Four bikes are assembled in parallel, then the van delivers to two sites one after the other.

scenarios.name: One bike, one site
scenarios.description: A single bike: both multi-instance activities run exactly one instance.

scenarios.name: Bikes already assembled
scenarios.description: The bike list is empty, so Assemble bike is skipped and the token goes straight to the deliveries.

scenarios.name: Sites missing
scenarios.description: sites is not set, so the collection of Deliver to site cannot be read. The simulation falls back to 3 instances and logs why.
